title: RetrievalEvaluationSchema
description: Schema for retrieval benchmark evaluation datasets and performance metrics reports.

eval_set_id.description: Identifier for this evaluation dataset, e.g. eval_nice_guidelines_v1

version.description: Semantic version of the evaluation set, e.g. 1.0.0

description.description: Description of the clinical domain and test methodology

id.description: Unique test case identifier, e.g. TC-001

query.description: Clinical search query formulated by a physician or candidate

gold_document_id.description: Target document ID containing the ground truth answer, or 'none' if unanswerable

gold_section.description: Target section heading containing the ground truth answer, or 'none' if unanswerable

gold_chunk_id.description: Optional specific chunk ID if pre-mapped

answerable.description: True if the query can be answered by the current knowledge base; false for negative controls
